Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1250379 (ELAV-like protein 1). Join activities to assays and target_dictionary filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL1250379. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to obtain molecule ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES. Filter rows where standard_type is IC50, standard_relation is '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit output to the first 1000 rows.
